title: Connection Management in Serverless
description: Manage Prisma database connections effectively in serverless and Next.js environments.

data.text: Serverless functions scale horizontally, which can quickly exhaust database connection pools if Prisma Client is instantiated on every invocation. Proper connection management is essential.
The singleton pattern reuses the same Prisma Client instance across function invocations, preventing connection leaks.

data.title: Singleton Prisma Client
data.content: Create a singleton Prisma Client in a shared module.

items: **App Router** — Use Prisma in Server Components, Server Actions, and Route Handlers only
**Pages Router** — Use Prisma in `getServerSideProps`, API routes, and server-side code
**Edge Runtime** — Prisma is not supported in Edge Runtime; use standard Node.js runtimes

data.title: Warning
data.text: Never create a new PrismaClient() inside a route handler or Server Component without a singleton. This will exhaust your database connection pool under load.
